title: Jingo
overview: Jingo is an upcoming Kannada satirical action-drama directed by Shashank Soghal and starring Daali Dhananjaya. The film follows an unconventional protagonist that uses a microphone to address the masses instead of using ballistic arms to ignite a revolution.
